dedupe_keys.name: rte electricity transmission sites overhead lines and underground lines of mainland france odre

description: These three linked data sets from RTE, the French transmission system operator, list the assets of the public electricity transmission network of mainland France on the ODRÉ open data platform (Open Data Réseaux Énergies). The sites data set, dated 16 June 2026, holds 5,042 electrical sites owned or co-owned by RTE or at the end of an RTE line, where a site groups all equipment of all voltage levels at one location, plus tapping points, with code, name, function, state, voltage and department. The overhead lines data set (9,221 sections) and the underground lines data set (3,825 sections), both stated as at 16 June 2026, give line sections of identical characteristics with line codes and names, state, voltage and number of circuits, listing lines that share pylons; a full line can need consolidation across the two files. RTE states it changed access to GPS data of transmission infrastructure for public security reasons and now publishes the data in this new form, so the current files have no coordinates. Files are free through the portal and API under Licence Ouverte 2.0. Caveats: the lack of geometry limits spatial analysis, and line sections must be joined to sites by code. Simulation uses are building the French transmission network topology for flow and contingency studies and listing critical substations. Related records: data-gridkit-power-grid-extracts gives mapped European grid geometry.
